 ;It is designed to assist with input validation and transformation.
7706dc3b:  ;Entry point for the utility. The main functionality is encapsulated in the subroutines below.
53ff3daf: ;Convert lowercase letters in X to uppercase.
46b376ba: ;Loop through Z string; if X is a substring of Z, print each character of Z starting from the character immediately following X until a delimiter or end of string.
e5134c9a: ;Set % to -1 if X is not found in Z or if X is empty, indicating a failure or no operation needed.
40372d5a: ;If no character was printed (%=0), reset X to its first character and kill Z to clean up.
